extracted.name: Scotch Bonnet Hot Sauce
extracted.description: This Scotch bonnet hot sauce recipe uses Scotch bonnets, jalapeños, onion, garlic, vinegar, and sugar to make one of the spiciest homemade hot sauces.
ingredient_lines: 18 fresh Scotch Bonnet peppers, sliced and seeded
instruction_lines: Cook peppers, onion, garlic, oil, and salt in a large saucepan over medium-high heat, stirring frequently, 5 minutes.
Pour in water; cook and stir until peppers are soft, about 20 minutes. Cool to room temperature.
Transfer mixture to a blender and purée until smooth. Pour in vinegar and sugar; blend until mixed.
Transfer to a container. Cover and store in the refrigerator.
